results.name: parseRules rejects 18 malformed shapes with a message naming the rule; accepts and normalises a good list
inSchedule equals the minute-of-week oracle on every minute of the week for 60 schedules (incl. overnight, Sat→Sun)
localTime: New York DST jumps, +05:30 / +12:45 offsets, unknown zone falls back to UTC (flagged)
decide: every active rule must let the alert through; the first blocking one is recorded; inactive rules never hold
the reason sentence names the rule, its condition, the app, what breaks through and the alert's priority
validateSetting: alerts.focusRules uses the same parser; alerts.timeZone is checked with Intl ('' = UTC)
